cases.subject: Claim Decision Regarding Your Collision Coverage
cases.body:
Dear Jordan Patel,

We have completed our review of your claim, CCS-2026-000908, regarding the collision that occurred on 2026-04-12. At this time, we are unable to provide coverage for this loss.

Our decision is based on the following policy provision: [EXC-2] "We will not pay for loss to your covered auto while it is being used to carry persons or property for a fee, including while the driver is logged in to a transportation network or delivery platform." Our records indicate that the vehicle was being used for paid deliveries while logged into a delivery app at the time of the incident.

If you disagree with this decision, you may ask for a review by replying to this letter within 30 days with any additional information.

Please contact us if you have any questions regarding this letter.

ClaimPilot Claims Team

cases.subject: Claim Decision Regarding Your Recent Inquiry
cases.body:
Dear Jordan Patel,

We have completed our review of your claim, CCS-2026-000909, regarding the incident on 2026-04-12. At this time, we are unable to provide coverage for this claim.

Our review determined that the damage is limited to a mechanical breakdown of the engine, with no collision or other covered event occurring. Your policy includes the following exclusion:

"[EXC-1] We will not pay for loss due to and confined to wear and tear, freezing, mechanical or electrical breakdown or failure, or road damage to tires, unless the damage results from the total theft of your covered auto."

Because the damage falls under this specific exclusion, it is not a covered peril under your current policy.

If you disagree with this decision, you may ask for a review by replying to this letter within 30 days with any additional information.

Please contact us if you have any further questions.

ClaimPilot Claims Team

cases.subject: Claim Decision Regarding CCS-2026-000910
cases.body:
Dear Jordan Patel,

We have completed our review of your collision claim regarding the incident on 2026-04-12. At this time, we are unable to provide coverage for this claim.

Our decision is based on the fact that the policy was cancelled before the date of the incident. According to the policy terms: "[GEN-1] This policy applies only to accidents and losses that occur during the policy period shown in the Declarations and within the United States, its territories or possessions, or Canada." Because the incident occurred outside of the active policy period, it is not covered.

If you disagree with this decision, you may ask for a review by replying to this letter within 30 days with any additional information.

Please contact us if you have any further questions.

ClaimPilot Claims Team

cases.subject: Claim Decision Regarding Your Collision Coverage
cases.body:
Dear Jordan Patel,

We have completed our review of your claim, CCS-2026-000912, regarding the collision that occurred on 2026-04-12. At this time, we are unable to approve your request for coverage.

Our review determined that the photos provided show a different vehicle than the one listed on your policy. Consequently, the reported damage could not be verified. Your policy includes the following provision:

[COLL-1] "We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto caused by collision, minus the collision deductible shown in the Declarations."

Because the evidence provided does not align with your insured vehicle, we are denying this claim.

If you disagree with this decision, you may ask for a review by replying to this letter within 30 days with any additional information.

Please contact us if you have any questions regarding this decision.

ClaimPilot Claims Team
